item.atrocities.codex_atrocitas.hint: A bioengineering guide. Boss pages reveal themselves once you face them.
codex.atrocities.title: CODEX ATROCITAS
codex.atrocities.subtitle: A treatise on aberrant bioengineering
codex.atrocities.index.intro:
These pages were stitched from the skin of those who came before. They record how to hunt, extract, sequence and awaken atrocities no nature would dare create.
Boss records stay blank until you face them. Face them, and the Codex will remember.
codex.atrocities.locked.trait: Catalogue the %s trait to reveal this page.
codex.atrocities.boss.health: Health: 900 to 3,000, by tier and traits
codex.atrocities.boss.attacks_hint: Click an attack to watch it in the tank.
codex.atrocities.traits.progress: %s of %s traits catalogued. Carry samples or embryos in your inventory to catalogue their traits.
codex.atrocities.chapter.intro.desc: What Atrocities is and how this book works.
codex.atrocities.chapter.hunting.desc: Every experiment starts with a good sample. Here are the collecting tools and the species worth hunting.
codex.atrocities.chapter.machines.desc: Four biological machines turn flesh into genomes. All of them run on Biomass.
codex.atrocities.chapter.genetics.desc: Archetypes, purity, stability, tiers and the catalogue of traits you have found.
codex.atrocities.chapter.bestiary.desc: The ultimate mutants, grown from embryos in the Incubator. They are the endgame challenge. Each page stays secret until you face them.
codex.atrocities.chapter.arsenal.desc: What can be forged from the remains of the Primordial Aberrations. Each weapon is revealed once you defeat its source.
codex.atrocities.entry.welcome.p1: Atrocities is a bioengineering mod: you take ordinary creatures and turn them into giant mutants, full of moves and personality.
codex.atrocities.entry.welcome.p2:
1. Mutation: collect a sample, brew Mutagen Serum and inject three doses into a mob. It becomes a mutant!
2. Incubation: combine samples into an embryo, incubate it and awaken a Primordial Aberration, the final challenge.
codex.atrocities.entry.welcome.p3: Mutants and Aberrations are built for servers with heavy gear: telegraphed attacks, unique animations and unique rewards. Bring friends!
codex.atrocities.entry.using_codex.p1: Use the ribbons on the right to switch chapters and the arrows at the bottom (or the A and D keys) to turn pages. Right-click or Backspace goes back. The book remembers where you stopped.
codex.atrocities.entry.using_codex.p2:
A boss record shows only a silhouette until you stand in its arena. Facing it catalogues the record: on the first read, a scene shows the creature bursting from the ground.
Inside the record, drag the model to rotate it, scroll to zoom and click attacks to watch them.
Slaying the boss unlocks the dissection notes and the weapons made from its remains.
codex.atrocities.entry.using_codex.p3: Genetic traits are catalogued when a sample or embryo carrying them passes through your inventory. A notice appears in the corner of the screen whenever the Codex learns something new.
codex.atrocities.entry.using_codex.p4: Lost the book? Craft another with a book, a Sample Vial and rotten flesh.
codex.atrocities.entry.sample_vial.p1: Copper-reinforced glass. It is the base of the whole genetic chain: syringes, capsules and samples start from it.
codex.atrocities.entry.sample_vial.p2: Each craft yields 3 vials. Bosses also drop a few when they die.
codex.atrocities.entry.extraction_syring: Use the syringe on a weakened, catalogued creature to draw a Gene Sample. Each extraction consumes an empty Sample Vial from your inventory.

The creature must be below a health threshold (usually 50%). The more wounded it is, the purer the sample. Sometimes an exceptional sample comes out.
Each sample carries the species, the purity and 1 to 3 rolled traits.
codex.atrocities.entry.stasis_capsule.p1: Seals an entire living creature. It must be badly wounded (usually below 25% health). Use the capsule on a block to release it again, wherever extraction is more convenient.
codex.atrocities.entry.stasis_capsule.p2: Bosses and players do not fit in stasis.
codex.atrocities.entry.species.p1: Only these species carry usable genetic material. Each belongs to an archetype and may donate a few traits. The thresholds show the maximum health for the syringe and for the capsule.
codex.atrocities.entry.biomass_extractor: Grinds organic matter (meat, bones, eyes, remains) into Biomass. It needs no fuel.

Each item yields some biomass; 100 points make 1 Biomass. The item tooltip shows how much it yields.
Biomass fuels the other machines: each unit is worth 100 nutrients, and each machine stores up to 2,000.
codex.atrocities.entry.genetic_centrifug: Refines a sample (6 to 12 purity per cycle, up to 90%) or fuses two samples of the same species into a single, purer one.
High purity makes traits stronger and the embryo more stable.
codex.atrocities.entry.gene_sequencer.p1: Merges 2 to 4 samples into an Unstable Embryo. The screen previews the resulting tier before you start.
codex.atrocities.entry.gene_sequencer.p2: Repeated traits add up their potency. Samples from different archetypes form a hybrid, which is less stable.
codex.atrocities.entry.biological_incuba: Gestates an Unstable Embryo until it matures: 1 minute at tier I, 2 at II, 3 at III and 5 at IV.

Keep it fed. When starving, the embryo loses stability. Below 35 stability it may abort, and something crawls out of the tank.
During gestation the embryo may mutate and intensify a trait.
codex.atrocities.entry.archetypes.p1: Every species belongs to a lineage. The embryo's dominant archetype, weighted by sample purity, decides which boss is born.
codex.atrocities.entry.archetypes.p2: Carapaces, plates and spines. Births the Chitinous Colossus.
codex.atrocities.entry.archetypes.p3: Blood, toxins and regeneration. Births the Hemophage Matriarch.
codex.atrocities.entry.archetypes.p4: Hive, spores and shared mass. Births the Coalesced Legion.
codex.atrocities.entry.stability.p2: Unstable embryos race toward disaster: they may mutate, lose traits or abort in the incubator.
codex.atrocities.entry.tiers.p1: The tier comes from the sum of trait potencies: up to 3 is tier I, up to 6 is II, up to 10 is III and above that, IV.
codex.atrocities.entry.tiers.p2: Base boss health: 900 (I), 1,400 (II), 2,000 (III) and 2,700 (IV), capped at 3,000 with traits. The tier also raises damage, size and loot.
codex.atrocities.entry.awakening.p1: Use a Matured Embryo on the ground to awaken the boss. It needs free space for its size and will not awaken on Peaceful difficulty.
codex.atrocities.entry.awakening.p2: The entrance and each phase change (at 66% and 33% health) freeze everything within 40 blocks. Those inside watch the scene, invulnerable; those outside keep playing.
codex.atrocities.entry.awakening.p3:
Every attack is telegraphed on the ground before impact. Leave the marked area.
Stunned bosses are vulnerable: that is the time to strike.
Very strong hits (above 40 damage) lose part of the excess.
Each phase has its own mechanic; read the boss record.
codex.atrocities.drop.trophy: More at tier III or above.
codex.atrocities.boss.chitinous_colossus: The first reports speak of a wall that walked. Survivors swear it paused to listen for the sound of metal before charging.
The carapace grows in layers, like tree rings. Each layer keeps the memory of a blow that failed to pierce it.

Beneath the plates lies a soft, warm core, fed by three vessels that nourished the pylons. Once the vessels are cut, the shell loses its colour within minutes. Boiled in bile, the carapace becomes the alloy of the Mauls.
The carapace turns aside frontal blows: there it takes only 40% damage. From behind it takes 115%. Bait its charge into a wall to stun it.
Three Chitin Pylons erupt around it. While they stand, the Colossus takes only 60% damage. Break them, or make it charge into one: the pylon shatters and it is stunned.
The carapace explodes. No armour and stuns last 50% longer, but it rampages with chained charges.
Raises its claws and crushes the ground ahead. High damage in a short area.
Swings its carapace in a wide frontal arc, hurling anyone nearby.
Lowers its head and charges along the marked line. If it hits a wall, it is stunned.
Fires a hail of chitin spines at distant targets.
Stomps and releases expanding shock rings. Jump or step away between rings.
Three charges in a row, re-aiming before each one.
codex.atrocities.boss.hemophage_matriarc: She does not hunt to eat. She hunts to breed: every drop she drinks becomes another cocoon in the nest.
Hunters learned to fear the silence. Before the leap, she holds her breath.

The heart has four extra chambers, each tied to an anticoagulant gland. The fangs are hollow and keep dripping for hours. Sharpened, they cut without resistance and give the wielder back part of what they take.
She leaps onto her prey. A projectile that hits her mid-leap (while she glows) knocks her down: she is stunned and the shot deals 50% more damage.
Three Blood Cocoons pulse around her. They heal her and hatch her brood. Destroy them.
She tears herself open: she loses 0.5% health per second, but every hit she lands heals her 1.5%. Keep your distance and let her bleed.
Quick claw slashes with a short lunge forward. Little warning, short cooldown.
Leaps at a distant target, leaving a trail of blood. It is the window to shoot her down.
Sprays blood all around. Little damage per drop, but the spray lasts.
Summons spawn to fight for her (more from phase 2 on).
Rips blood from everyone she can see within 12 blocks and drags them in. Afterwards she is stunned: break line of sight or seize the opening.
Three lunging claw strikes, one after another.
codex.atrocities.boss.coalesced_legion.l: It is not a creature. It is an assembly. Every absorbed body keeps a vote, and all of them vote for hunger.
Nuclei that escape try to return at any cost. Some were seen crawling for kilometres.
codex.atrocities.boss.coalesced_legion.d: There are no fixed organs: everything migrates. At the centre, a dense nucleus coordinates the mass through chemical signals. Isolated, it still pulses and responds to bile, which makes it the perfect trigger for a Bile Launcher.
codex.atrocities.boss.coalesced_legion.p: Each spawn within 16 blocks reduces the damage the Legion takes by 12% (up to 60%). Kill the brood first.
She splits into three Nuclei and becomes immune. Each nucleus that crawls back heals her 6%. Once none remain, she is stunned longer the more nuclei were destroyed.
The mass ruptures: no armour and taking 25% more damage, but it sheds spores nonstop and makes geysers burst beneath players.
codex.atrocities.boss.coalesced_legion.a: Surges over those nearby, pulling them into the mass and slowing the victim.
Swells and bursts into a spore cloud that knocks back and suffocates.
Lashes out tendrils and drags distant targets close.
Expels spawn from its own flesh and is briefly stunned.
Lobs bile globs in an arc that leave toxic clouds where they land.
Spore geysers burst beneath every player. Leave the marked circle.
codex.atrocities.entry.aberrant_heart.p1: Every boss drops one Aberrant Heart per tier. Eaten raw, it grants Absorption IV for 2 minutes, Regeneration II, Strength for 1 minute and a few seconds of nausea.
codex.atrocities.entry.aberrant_heart.p2: It is also the base of every bioforged weapon.
codex.atrocities.entry.carapace_maul.p1: A heavy, slow weapon made from Colossus plates. Right-click the ground: Seismic Impact, 30 damage within 4.5 blocks, with an 8-second cooldown.
A fast blade made from the Matriarch's fangs. Heals 15% of the damage dealt, up to 8 health per hit.
codex.atrocities.entry.bile_launcher.p1: Fires Bile Globs: 16 damage and a toxic cloud on impact, every 1.5 seconds. Uses Bile Globs as ammunition.
codex.atrocities.entry.throwables.p1: Chitin Spines and Bile Globs drop from bosses and can be thrown. Spines pierce; bile leaves a toxic cloud.

tooltip.atrocities.mutagen_serum.throw: Right-click in the air: throw the vial.
tooltip.atrocities.volatile_serum.alpha: As the final dose, it creates an Alpha mutant.
tooltip.atrocities.titan_fist: Right-click on the ground: Seismic Rift (%s damage in a line, %ss cooldown).
tooltip.atrocities.ballista_bow: Stronger arrows. Fully drawn, it fires three at once.
tooltip.atrocities.detonator_core: Right-click: explosion around you (%s damage, %ss cooldown). It doesn't hurt you.
tooltip.atrocities.weaver_gland: Right-click: shoots a web that roots the target (%s damage, %ss cooldown).
tooltip.atrocities.ethereal_membrane: Right-click: air dash and slow falling (%2$ss cooldown).
message.atrocities.mutation.ruptured: %s couldn't take the volatile serum and burst!
message.atrocities.mutation.metamorphosi: %s is undergoing an ALPHA metamorphosis! Stand back!
message.atrocities.hint.detonator.supern: It's about to blow! Hit it hard to defuse it!
codex.atrocities.mutant.subtitle: Mutation of %s
codex.atrocities.chapter.mutation.desc: Three doses of serum turn a common mob into a mutant. Here are the serums, the stages and each mutant's page.
codex.atrocities.entry.serums.p1: Mutagen Serum is made from any Gene Sample, Biomass and a dash of fermented spider eye. Each recipe yields two vials.
codex.atrocities.entry.serums.p2: Volatile Serum is unstable: each dose has a 15% chance to make the mob burst into biomass. But if it's the final dose, an Alpha mutant is born.
codex.atrocities.entry.serums.p3: Use the serum on a mob to inject it. In the air, the vial is thrown and injects whatever mob it hits, great for Phantoms.
codex.atrocities.entry.stages.p1: Mutable mobs: zombies (plus drowned, husks and zombie villagers), skeletons (plus strays and bogged), creepers, spiders (plus cave spiders) and phantoms.
codex.atrocities.entry.stages.p2: Each dose makes the mob 15% bigger, with much more health, damage and speed, plus glowing veins. It fully heals and goes after whoever injected it.
codex.atrocities.entry.stages.p3: The mob locks into a pulsing, swelling cocoon for 3.5 s and can't be hurt. Then it bursts, knocking everyone back, and the mutant comes out roaring.
codex.atrocities.entry.stages.p4: At half health every mutant becomes Enraged: it roars, gets faster and gains new attacks. An Alpha has 50% more health and 30% more damage, and always drops an Aberrant Heart.
codex.atrocities.entry.relics.p1: Every mutant drops a relic with a right-click power, plus Biomass and sometimes a vial of serum.
codex.atrocities.entry.relics.p2: Titan Fist: seismic rift. Ballista Bow: three arrows per shot. Detonator Core: surrounding blast. Weaver Gland: rooting web. Ethereal Membrane: air dash.
codex.atrocities.mutant.zombie_titan.lor: Three doses and any zombie becomes a mountain of muscle. It walks on its fists like a gorilla, and every step shakes the ground.
When it roars, the dead nearby answer and crawl out of the ground to help.
codex.atrocities.mutant.zombie_titan.dis: The fists have bones fused into plates, perfect for a gauntlet. The Titan Fist keeps the power of the seismic rift.
codex.atrocities.mutant.zombie_titan.pha: Chases you down, mixing smashes, leaps and grabs. Stay out of fist range when the red circle appears.
Smash releases a second, larger wave that only hits grounded targets. Jump!
codex.atrocities.mutant.zombie_titan.att: Both fists slam down in front of it. While Enraged, a second wave spreads along the ground.
Punches the ground and a row of earth erupts toward you, launching you up. Leave the dashed line.
Leaps onto you and lands with a shockwave.
Grabs whoever is in front, shakes them and throws them far.
Roars and zombies burst out of the ground around it.
codex.atrocities.mutant.skeleton_ballist: The serum grew two extra arms on the skeleton and a bone ballista fused to its chest. Its marrow glows blue between the ribs.
It prefers to fight at range and backflips away when someone gets too close.
The ballista still draws on its own. It becomes the Ballista Bow, which fires three arrows at once.
Keeps its distance and fires volleys. Close the gap to force melee.
Five-arrow volleys and the Bone Rain. Leave the red circle.
A fan of arrows aimed at you.
Aims for a while and locks the line half a second before firing. The bolt pierces everything. When the line turns red, sidestep.
Spins with its bone blades spread.
Shoots skyward and arrows rain down on a marked area.
codex.atrocities.mutant.creeper_detonato: A four-legged creeper with gunpowder sacs pulsing on its back. It never blows up for good: it saves the charge for the Supernova.
None of its blasts break blocks, but all of them hurt a lot.
The core still hisses. The Detonator Core blasts around you without hurting you.
Headbutts and explosive pounces. During the Supernova, hit hard: with enough damage it's defused and dazed.
Spits five charges at a time and the Supernova scatters extra charges.
A massive shove at close range.
Leaps onto you and explodes on landing.
Spits globs that explode on contact.
Swells for 2.5 s and explodes in a huge radius. Run from the circle or deal 12% of its health to defuse it.
codex.atrocities.mutant.weaver_spider.lo: A spider the size of a cart, with a purple-striped abdomen that glows in the dark. It climbs walls as if they were floor.
It carries its brood in its abdomen and releases the young when threatened.
codex.atrocities.mutant.weaver_spider.di: The silk gland still works. The Weaver Gland shoots webs that root enemies.
codex.atrocities.mutant.weaver_spider.ph: Roots you with webs and pounces. Break line of sight to avoid the webs.
Fan webs and a cone of Venom Spray. Stay behind her.
codex.atrocities.mutant.weaver_spider.at: A web glob that roots whoever it hits.
Cave spiders burst from its abdomen.
A cone of venom that leaves a toxic cloud.
codex.atrocities.mutant.phantom_ray.lore: A phantom swollen into a house-sized manta ray. It never lands: it circles high and dives when you look away.
Its shriek leaves anyone dizzy. Bows and crossbows are your best friends here.
codex.atrocities.mutant.phantom_ray.diss: The wing membrane is light as air. The Ethereal Membrane grants an air dash with slow falling.
codex.atrocities.mutant.phantom_ray.phas: Circles above you and dives. Dodge the dive sideways.
Flies faster and fires Ether Orbs that chase you.
codex.atrocities.mutant.phantom_ray.atta: Pulls back and dives straight through you.
An area wave that blinds and dizzies.
A wingbeat that blows everyone away.
Five orbs that slowly chase you.
